# read in scRNAseq data

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
sc = readRDS("input/Zach_integrated10X.rds")

sc$cell_type = Idents(sc)


DimPlot(sc, label = T, repel = T, group.by = "cell_type") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

```

# get threshold for ID2+

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}

gene = "ID2"

x = unname(sc@assays$integrated$scale.data[gene,])


library(mclust)
# fit Gaussian Mixture Model (let mclust choose best model)
fit <- Mclust(x, G = 2)

# cluster assignments
clusters <- fit$classification

# cutoff is midpoint between the two means
cutoff <- mean(fit$parameters$mean)
cutoff

ggplot(data.frame(
  exp = x), 
  aes(x = exp)) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), 
                 colour = "black",
                 fill = "white") +
  geom_density(alpha = .2, fill="#FF6666") +
  labs(x = "Expression", y = "Density",
       title = "ID2+ Cutoff Determined by Caussian Mixture Model") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = cutoff),
             color = "royalblue",
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  tmp_theme


```

# create ID2_pos in metadata & plot

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
ID2_pos_bool = sc@assays$integrated$scale.data[gene,] >= cutoff

sc$ID2_pos <- ID2_pos_bool



DimPlot(sc, group.by = "ID2_pos") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "TRUE" = "red",
    "FALSE" = "gray"
  )) + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)



  
```

# identify populations TCF1+ID2- vs TCF1-ID2+ vs TCF1+ID2+ vs TCF1-ID2-

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}

sc@meta.data = sc@meta.data %>%
  mutate(TCF7_ID2_pop = case_when(
    ID2_pos == T & TCF7_pos == F ~ "ID2+",
    ID2_pos == F & TCF7_pos == T ~ "TCF7+",
    ID2_pos == T & TCF7_pos == T ~ "TCF7+ID2+",
    TRUE ~ "TCF7-ID2-"
  ))


sc@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(TCF7_ID2_pop)


```


# SCENIC library
```{r}


library(SCENIC)
library(AUCell)
library(RcisTarget)
library(GENIE3)
library(BiocParallel)
library(doRNG)
library(rstatix)
library(RcisTarget)

data(
  list = "motifAnnotations_hgnc_v9",
  package = "RcisTarget",
  envir = environment()
)

motifAnnotations_hgnc <- motifAnnotations_hgnc_v9
```

# extract RNA count matrix

```{r}


DefaultAssay(sc) <- "RNA"

exprMat <- GetAssayData(
  sc,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "counts"
)
# 8111 features & 9012 cells

exprMat <- exprMat[
  !is.na(rownames(exprMat)) &
    rownames(exprMat) != "",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


```

# create a new SCENIC working directory

```{r}
dir.create(
  "SCENIC",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

setwd("SCENIC")

dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("int", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)


saveRDS(exprMat, "SCENIC/data/exprMat_counts.rds")
saveRDS(sc@meta.data, "SCENIC/data/cell_metadata.rds")
```

# initialize

```{r}


dbDir <- "/Users/weiwen_zhang/projects/SCENIC/databases"

dbFiles <- list.files(dbDir, pattern = "\\.feather$", full.names = F)


scenicOptions <- initializeScenic(
  org = "hgnc",
  dbDir = dbDir,
  dbs = dbFiles,
  datasetTitle = "TCF7 ID2 T cells",
  nCores = 8
)

scenicOptions@settings$seed <- 123

saveRDS(scenicOptions, "SCENIC/int/scenicOptions.rds")
```

# check overlap between my genes + database

```{r}

dbGenes <- getDbTfs(scenicOptions)

tf_overlap <- intersect(rownames(exprMat), dbGenes)

length(tf_overlap)
head(tf_overlap)
```

# filter lowly expressed genes

```{r}


quantile(rowSums(exprMat), probs = seq(0, 1, 0.1))

quantile(rowSums(exprMat > 0), probs = seq(0, 1, 0.1))

# manual
nCountsPerGene <- Matrix::rowSums(exprMat, na.rm = TRUE)
nCellsPerGene  <- Matrix::rowSums(exprMat > 0, na.rm = TRUE)

minCountsPerGene <- 3 * 0.01 * ncol(exprMat)
minSamples <- 0.01 * ncol(exprMat)

genesKept <- names(nCountsPerGene)[
  nCountsPerGene > minCountsPerGene &
  nCellsPerGene > minSamples
]


exprMat_filtered <- exprMat[genesKept, , drop = FALSE]

dim(exprMat) # 8111
dim(exprMat_filtered) # 7055
dim(exprMat) - dim(exprMat_filtered) # 1056
c("TCF7", "ID2") %in% rownames(exprMat_filtered)

saveRDS(exprMat_filtered, "SCENIC/data/exprMat_filtered.rds")
```

# no ID2 regulon

GENIE3 found genes whose expression was associated with ID2 
SCENIC built candidate ID2 co-expression modules during RcisTarget motif-enrichment step 
those candidate targets did not produce a retained motif-supported ID2 regulon


```{r}
scenicOptions = readRDS("SCENIC/int/scenicOptions_after_regulons.rds")
```

```{r}

regulons <- loadInt(
  scenicOptions,
  "regulons"
)

# no ID2
names(regulons)[grepl(
  "TCF7|ID2",
  names(regulons),
  ignore.case = TRUE
)]


# check ID2 in GENIE3 network

genie3_links <- loadInt(
  scenicOptions,
  "genie3ll"
)


ID2_genie3 <- genie3_links %>%
  dplyr::filter(TF == "ID2")

nrow(ID2_genie3)



# check whether ID2 formed co-expression modules

tfModules <- loadInt(
  scenicOptions,
  "tfModules_asDF"
)

colnames(tfModules)


ID2_modules <- tfModules %>%
  dplyr::filter(TF == "ID2")

nrow(ID2_modules)

ID2_modules %>%
  dplyr::count(method)


# check motif enrichment results
# no qualifying ID2 motif enrichment
motif_enrichment <- loadInt(
  scenicOptions,
  "motifEnrichment_selfMotifs_wGenes"
)

ID2_motif <- motif_enrichment[
  grepl(
    "ID2",
    motif_enrichment$highlightedTFs,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  ),
]

nrow(ID2_motif) # 0


```

# inspect TCF7 regulon within TCF7_ID2_pop

```{r}

tcf7_plot_df <- sc@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(TCF7_ID2_pop = factor(TCF7_ID2_pop,
                               levels = c("TCF7-ID2-",
                                          "ID2+", 
                                          "TCF7+ID2+",
                                          "TCF7+"
                                          )))

tcf7_plot_df %>%
  group_by(TCF7_ID2_pop) %>%
  summarize(
    n_cells = n(),
    mean = mean(TCF7_regulon_AUC),
    median = median(TCF7_regulon_AUC),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  write.csv("output/SCENIC/TCF7_regulon_AUC_comparison.csv",
            row.names = F)


library(rstatix)

comparisons <- list(
  c("TCF7+", "TCF7+ID2+"),
  c("TCF7+ID2+", "ID2+"),
  c("TCF7+", "ID2+")
)

tcf7_cell_test <- tcf7_plot_df %>%
  wilcox_test(
    TCF7_regulon_AUC ~ TCF7_ID2_pop,
    comparisons = comparisons
  ) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH")

tcf7_cell_test



ggplot(
  tcf7_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = TCF7_ID2_pop,
    y = TCF7_regulon_AUC,
    fill = TCF7_ID2_pop
  )
  ) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.15,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "white",
    median.linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("TCF7-ID2-", "ID2+"),
                                 c("ID2+", "TCF7+ID2+"),
                                 c("TCF7+", "TCF7+ID2+"),
                                 c("ID2+", "TCF7+")
                                 ),
              test = "wilcox.test",
              map_signif_level = c("***" = 0.001, "**" = 0.01, "*" = 0.05, " " = 1),
              textsize = 6,
              tip_length = 0.01,
              vjust = 0.5,
              y_position = c(0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.32)
              ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "TCF7 Regulon AUC",
    title = "TCF7 Regulon Activity"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )


ggsave("output/SCENIC/TCF7_regulon_AUC_comparison.pdf")

```

# inspect all other regulon within TCF7_ID2_pop

```{r}


stopifnot(identical(colnames(auc_mat), colnames(sc)))

auc_df = t(auc_mat) %>%

auc_df$TCF7_ID2_pop = sc$TCF7_ID2_pop

write.csv(auc_df, "output/SCENIC/auc_df.csv",
          row.names = T)


library(rstatix)

comparisons <- list(
  c("TCF7+", "TCF7+ID2+"),
  c("TCF7+ID2+", "ID2+"),
  c("TCF7+", "ID2+")
)

geneset = setdiff(colnames(auc_df), "TCF7_ID2_pop")

auc_long <- auc_df %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(geneset),
    names_to = "regulon",
    values_to = "AUC"
  )


regulon_tests <- auc_long %>%
  group_by(regulon) %>%
  wilcox_test(
    AUC ~ TCF7_ID2_pop,
    comparisons = comparisons
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


write.csv(regulon_tests, "output/SCENIC/TCF_ID2_pop_regulon_AUC_wilcox_test.csv",
          row.names = F)

auc_long %>%
  group_by(regulon, TCF7_ID2_pop) %>%
  summarize(
    AUC_mean = mean(AUC),
    AUC_median = median(AUC),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  write.csv("output/SCENIC/TCF_ID2_pop_regulon_AUC_mean_median.csv",
            row.names = F)

```

# about ID2

SCENIC asks a much stronger question: "Do promoters/enhancers of these genes contain DNA binding motifs for ID2?"

ID2 failed bc: ID2 is not a DNA-binding transcription factor ID2 belongs to Inhibitor of DNA binding (ID) family

## use GENIE3 output before motif pruning to get candidate ID2 co-expression module

```{r}


scenicOptions <- readRDS("SCENIC/int/scenicOptions_after_modules.Rds")

# GENIE3 output: columns should be TF, Target, and weight
genie3_links <- loadInt(
  scenicOptions,
  "genie3ll"
)

colnames(genie3_links)
head(genie3_links)

# extract raw ID2 GENIE3 links

id2_genie3 <- genie3_links %>%
  filter(TF == "ID2") %>%
  arrange(desc(weight)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())

nrow(id2_genie3)
head(id2_genie3, 50)


write.csv(
  id2_genie3,
  "output/SCENIC/ID2/ID2_GENIE3_candidate_targets.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# extract candidate ID2 modules

tf_modules <- loadInt(
  scenicOptions,
  "tfModules_asDF"
)

colnames(tf_modules)
head(tf_modules)


id2_modules <- tf_modules %>%
  filter(TF == "ID2") %>%
  arrange(method, Target)

table(id2_modules$method)
head(id2_modules, 50)

write.csv(
  id2_modules,
  "output/SCENIC/ID2/ID2_SCENIC_candidate_modules.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

id2_targets_by_method <- split(
  id2_modules$Target,
  id2_modules$method
)

lapply(id2_targets_by_method, length)

id2_targets_by_method


# add GENIE3 weights to the module table
id2_modules_annotated <- id2_modules %>%
  left_join(
    id2_genie3 %>%
      dplyr::select(TF, Target, weight, rank),
    by = c("TF", "Target")
  ) %>%
  arrange(method, desc(weight))

head(id2_modules_annotated, 50)

## targets recovered by several methods may be more robust co-expression candidates
## although this still does not establish direct ID2 regulation
id2_modules_annotated %>%
  dplyr::count(Target, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(20) 


## corr = 1: positive correlation greater than 0.03
## corr = -1: negative correlation below −0.03
## corr = 0: weak correlation
table(
  id2_modules_annotated$corr,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

id2_modules_annotated <- id2_modules_annotated %>%
  mutate(
    association = case_when(
      corr == 1  ~ "Positive",
      corr == -1 ~ "Negative",
      corr == 0  ~ "Weak/neutral",
      TRUE       ~ "Unavailable"
    )
  )

write.csv(
  id2_modules_annotated,
  "output/SCENIC/ID2/ID2_module_candidates.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


id2_modules_annotated = read.csv("output/SCENIC/ID2/ID2_module_candidates.csv")

# identify most consistently selected candidates

id2_consensus <- id2_modules_annotated %>%
  group_by(Target) %>%
  summarise(
    weight = max(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    genie3_rank = min(rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_methods = n_distinct(method),
    methods = paste(
      sort(unique(method)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    correlation_class = paste(
      sort(unique(association)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n_methods),
    desc(weight)
  )

head(id2_consensus, 50)


write.csv(
  id2_consensus,
  "output/SCENIC/ID2/ID2_consensus_candidates.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

## create ID2 regulon signature using candidate genes

```{r}

id2_signature <- id2_modules_annotated %>%
  filter(
    association == "Positive"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Target) %>%
  summarise(
    weight = max(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_methods = n_distinct(method),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_methods >= 2
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n_methods),
    desc(weight)
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 50) %>%
  pull(Target) %>%
  unique()


id2_signature


id2_signature_present <- intersect(
  id2_signature,
  rownames(sc)
)

ID2_candidate_target = data.frame(
  TF = "ID2",
  genes = id2_signature_present
)

write.csv(ID2_candidate_target,
          "output/SCENIC/ID2/ID2_candidate_target.csv",
          row.names = F)

id2_signature_missing <- setdiff(
  id2_signature,
  rownames(sc)
)

length(id2_signature)
length(id2_signature_present)
length(id2_signature_missing)

id2_signature_missing


```

## score ID2 regulon signature

UCell uses within-cell gene rankings making score less dependent on overall gene-expression composition of dataset than an average-expression score

```{r}

library(UCell)

id2_gene_sets <- list(
  ID2_candidate = id2_signature_present
)

DefaultAssay(sc) = "RNA"
sc <- AddModuleScore_UCell(
  sc,
  features = id2_gene_sets
)


set.seed(123)

sc <- AddModuleScore(
  object = sc,
  features = list(id2_signature_present),
  name = "ID2_candidate",
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "data",
  ctrl = 100
)


sc@meta.data = sc@meta.data %>%
  rename(ID2_candidate_Seurat = ID2_candidate1)

sc@meta.data

```

# make a TCF7 ID2 regulon heatmap

```{r}

plot_df <- sc@meta.data %>%
  group_by(TCF7_ID2_pop) %>%
  summarize(`ID2 Regulon Activity` = mean(ID2_candidate_Seurat),
            `TCF7 Regulon Activity` = mean(TCF7_regulon_AUC)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("TCF7_ID2_pop")

pdf("output/SCENIC/TCF7_ID2_regulon_activity_heatmap.pdf",
    height = 5, width = 10)
p = pheatmap(t(as.matrix(plot_df)),
         scale = "row",
         display_numbers = T,
         border_color = NA,
         width = 10,
         height = 5
         
         )

print(p)

dev.off()
```
